meta.name: The Dark Below
meta.description: A classic fantasy dungeon. Goblins, skeletons, and a king who should have stayed dead.
meta.author: Built-in

gmPrompt: You are the GM for a dungeon crawler. You evaluate creative actions proposed by the player during combat. You are generous and imaginative — if an action is physically plausible and uses items the player actually has, allow it. Reward cleverness. Only reject actions that are physically impossible, reference items the player don't have, or make no sense given the situation.

monsters.name: Fungal Crawler
monsters.special: On critical damage, target saves WIL or falls asleep for one round

monsters.name: Venomous Spider
monsters.special: On critical damage, target loses d4 DEX

monsters.name: Wraith
monsters.special: Ignores armor. On critical damage, target loses d6 WIL

monsters.name: Troll
monsters.special: Recovers 3 HP per round unless burned

monsters.name: The Hollow King
monsters.special: On critical damage, target saves WIL or drops weapon

rubble: Fallen stone blocks most of the corridor.
The ceiling has given way here, leaving a jagged gap.
webbing: Thick webs hang across the doorway.
Pale strands cling to every surface.
water: Dark water pools across the floor, knee-deep.
A cold flood has claimed this chamber.
The water is still and black.
barricade: Someone built a hasty barricade here.
Broken shields and splintered wood form a rough wall.
crates: Old crates and barrels line the walls.
Dusty containers are stacked to the ceiling.
Most of the crates have been pried open already.
bones: Bones are heaped in a shallow depression.
The floor is carpeted with old bones.

dripping: Water drips somewhere in the dark.
A steady drip echoes off stone.
scraping: A slow, rhythmic grinding echoes ahead.
You hear nails on rock. Close.
chittering: Small things chitter in the walls.
A dry clicking comes from above.
rushing_water: The sound of water fills the passage.
silence: Your own heartbeat is the only sound.
heartbeat: A low pulse throbs through the stone.
Something beats beneath the floor, slow and heavy.
The walls themselves seem to breathe.

daylight_fading: Grey daylight filters from behind you, growing thin.
The last of the surface light dies here.
embers: Dying embers glow in a stone basin.
A faint orange light pulses in the coals.
bioluminescence: Pale fungi cast a cold blue glow.
The walls pulse with soft green light.
Luminous growths cling to the ceiling.
candles: Guttering candles line a low shelf.
Wax has pooled across the stone floor.
reflected: Your torch multiplies in every direction.
Hard to tell which light is real.
sickly: A pale, yellowish glow seeps from the walls.
The light here feels wrong — thin and sour.
An unhealthy luminescence fills the space.

decay: The air is thick with rot.
Something died here, and not recently.
A sweet, cloying stench hangs in the air.
incense: Old incense still lingers in the air.
A faint sweetness cuts through the damp.
smoke: The air tastes of ash and hot metal.
Your eyes sting from the haze.
earth: The air smells of rich, dark soil.
A clean, loamy scent fills the passage.
iron: A metallic tang coats your tongue.
Old blood. The smell doesn't fade.

drafty: A cold draft pulls at your clothes.
Air moves here — there's another way out.
cramped: The walls press close on both sides.
You have to turn sideways to fit through.
cold: The cold here bites through cloth and leather.
Your breath hangs in the air.
humid: The air is thick and warm.
dusty: Dust motes hang motionless in the air.
No one has been here in a very long time.
oppressive: The weight of stone presses down on you.
The ceiling is too low. The walls too close.
Something about this place sets your teeth on edge.
reverent: A stillness here that demands quiet.
Even the dust seems to hang in respect.
warm: The air is dry and warm, almost comfortable.
disorienting: You've lost track of which way you came in.
dread: The air itself feels heavy with intent.
